system.description: The character's bite spreads clan madness to mortals. Every three Blood Traits drawn from a mortal during feeding inflicts one temporary Derangement on the victim, lasting roughly a week — Malkavians with this Flaw are disproportionately drawn to feeding quietly in asylums, where a little more madness goes unnoticed.
system.source: Clanbook: Malkavian, New Merits and Flaws
